name: Snickers Bar
ingredients_raw: Milk Chocolate coating (35%): Sugar, Milk solids, Cocoa butter, Cocoa solids, Edible vegetable fats <5% (Sal fat, Palm oil), Dextrose, Emulsifier (322); Centre filling (65%): Liquid glucose, Peanuts (21%), Sugar, Fractionated vegetable fat, Milk solids, Iodized salt, Cocoa butter, Cocoa solids, Edible vegetable fats <5% (Sal fat, Palm oil), Dextrose, Emulsifier (322). CONTAINS COCOA BUTTER EQUIVALENT IN ADDITION TO COCOA BUTTER. Contains Milk, Peanut and Soy. May contain Treenuts.
